summary.headline: Apomasar and the 36 Decans
summary.text: Introduction to Apomasar’s book on images of the 36 rising decans, comparing its Indian, Persian, Arabic, Byzantine, and Ptolemaic spheres. The discussion traces the Indian sphere to Varāhamihira’s Bṛhaj-Jātaka and its transmission through Kanaka, Yaʿqūb ben Tāriq, Al-Mansūr, and Arabic translations.
